english.title: Clean / service / maintain an aircraft / vehicle / equipment in a prohibited area at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without permission of the Airport Company or other lawful excuse cleaned, serviced or maintained

(A)_[an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..),]_
(B)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..),]_

in an area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), at Stansted Airport London where such activities were prohibited by a written notice issued by the Airport Company
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(2) and 2(2) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
